- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Both hiking boots are suitable for day hikes, backpacking, and general outdoor activities.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Merrell Moab 2 has a more substantial ankle collar for additional support, while the Keen Targhee II has a more flexible ankle design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Merrell boots are known for being comfortable right out of the box, while Keen boots might require a longer break-in period.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Keen Targhee II Mid WP is generally priced lower than the Merrell Moab 2 Mid Waterproof.
